abstract.t: This document specifies a mechanism for resource discovery across cooperating administrative domains. It defines how discovery requests preserve their scope and constraints across referrals, how discovery services report coverage of requested scopes, and how clients combine results from multiple discovery branches. The mechanism enables clients to distinguish complete discovery results from incomplete operations, including cases involving unresolved referrals, pagination failures, and partial service failures. It relies on existing authentication, authorization, and trust arrangements and does not define open-ended Internet search, semantic matchmaking, resource invocation, registration, or directory synchronization.
